title: LA Mayor Karen Bass Eases Street Vending Crackdown After Debate
summary: Mayor Karen Bass said food vendors discourage restaurant patrons, mentioning them alongside homeless encampments. Her opponent, Nithya Raman, said vendors should be brought into the system.
